description: Returns the word-level speech transcript of one media asset: language and words [{text, startSec, endSec}]. Only assets the user has transcribed have one — NOT_FOUND means ask the user to run Transcribe on the clip in Frapea. Use the timestamps to align cuts with what is being said.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: get_transcript
